event.silent_foundry.name: The Silent Foundry
event.silent_foundry.title: The Silent Foundry
event.silent_foundry.body: The Marches' main furnaces have gone cold. Workers demand the end of wartime quotas while crown collectors threaten to hand the foundry to the garrison. Without a settlement, the army will lose its repairs.
event.silent_foundry.choice.workers: Support the workers and pay for emergency supplies
event.silent_foundry.choice.crown: Place the foundry under crown guard
event.silent_foundry.choice.mediate: Broker a temporary pact between guild and crown
event.wall_without_gate.name: The Wall Without a Gate
event.wall_without_gate.title: The Wall Without a Gate
event.wall_without_gate.body: An ancient wall cuts across the pass, yet it has no gate and bears no siege scars. Scouts hear a mechanical pulse inside the stone.
event.wall_without_gate.choice.breach: Break through and inspect the mechanism
event.wall_without_gate.choice.wait: Hire local guides and wait for the hidden passage
event.miners_on_strike.name: Miners on Strike
event.miners_on_strike.title: The Miners Lay Down Their Picks
event.miners_on_strike.body: The miners have locked the lifts after another quota increase. The garrison demands iron immediately, while the elders present lists of the dead.
event.miners_on_strike.choice.accept: Accept their demands and cover the stoppage
event.miners_on_strike.choice.guards: Order the garrison to reopen the mines by force
event.miners_on_strike.choice.audit: Suspend work and audit the owners' accounts
event.regents_tax.name: The Regent's Tax
event.regents_tax.title: The Regent's Tax
event.regents_tax.body: A collector waits on the royal road with the Iron Regent's flawless seal. The toll is lawful, but its price could derail the campaign.
event.regents_tax.choice.refuse: Refuse and face the garrison's challenge
event.regents_tax.choice.charter: Invoke a guild charter and demand review
event.cracked_bell.name: A Cracked Bell
event.cracked_bell.title: A Cracked Bell
event.cracked_bell.body: The bell that warned the fortresses of invasion has split in the frost. The townsfolk argue whether to restore the relic, melt it into arms, or preserve its final note in the Chronicle.
event.cracked_bell.choice.melt: Melt the bronze for the campaign
event.cracked_bell.choice.record: Keep a shard and record the final ringing
event.ninth_bastion.name: The Ninth Bastion
event.ninth_bastion.title: The Ninth Bastion
event.ninth_bastion.body: The last garrison of the Ninth Bastion holds a collapsed defense line. Its commander asks for supplies, the civilians ask for evacuation, and an engineer points to a flaw beneath the walls.
event.ninth_bastion.choice.reinforce: Reinforce the bastion and leave supplies
event.prisoners_pass.name: Prisoners of the Pass
event.prisoners_pass.title: Prisoners of the Pass
event.prisoners_pass.body: Deserters, debtors, and several enemy soldiers wait in the watchtower cells. The gaoler will obey any lawful order, but refuses responsibility for what follows.
event.prisoners_pass.choice.release: Release those whose guilt is unproven
event.prisoners_pass.choice.recruit: Offer service under a new oath
event.prisoners_pass.choice.exchange: Exchange the military prisoners for gold and intelligence
event.empty_armory.name: The Empty Armory
event.empty_armory.title: The Empty Armory
event.empty_armory.body: The armory doors are locked and the seals remain intact, yet not a single blade is inside. Fresh stone dust trails beneath the racks.
event.empty_armory.choice.search: Search for a passage below the armory
event.empty_armory.choice.rebuild: Purchase equipment and restore the stock
event.empty_armory.choice.seal: Seal the chamber until an inquiry is held
event.duel_masons.name: A Duel of Masons
event.duel_masons.title: A Duel of Masons
event.duel_masons.body: Two master builders accuse each other of bringing down a bridge. By custom, each must raise a supporting pier before sunset and let the stone judge between them.
event.duel_masons.choice.first: Support the master of the old school
event.duel_masons.choice.joint: Pay for a joint repair and cancel the duel
event.furnace_oath.name: The Furnace Oath
event.furnace_oath.title: The Furnace Oath
event.furnace_oath.body: Before an ancient furnace, the Marcher commanders demand an oath that the fortresses will be defended before the capital. Its wording has bound several dead dynasties.
event.furnace_oath.choice.decline: Refuse to bind the campaign to the old law
event.furnace_oath.choice.rewrite: Propose a new oath with mutual obligations
event.snow_black_iron.name: Snow over Black Iron
event.snow_black_iron.title: Snow over Black Iron
event.snow_black_iron.body: Black snow covers the road and swallows the caravan's sound. Shelter lies one march away, but the cold is already locking the armor joints.
event.disputed_standard.name: The Disputed Standard
event.disputed_standard.title: The Disputed Standard
event.disputed_standard.body: After the governor's death, three delegations claim the regimental standard: Marshal Varn, Heir Elda, and Borek's guild council. Any choice will become a public political promise.
event.disputed_standard.choice.marshal: Give the standard to Marshal Varn
event.disputed_standard.choice.council: Entrust the standard to the guild council
encounter.iron_crossfire_files.name: Crossfire Files
encounter.iron_crossfire_files.objective: Break one rook line and deliver a legal checkmate to the enemy king
encounter.iron_blocked_diagonal.name: Blocked Diagonal
encounter.iron_blocked_diagonal.objectiv: Navigate the visible blocking mechanism without exposing your own king
encounter.iron_broken_formation.name: Broken Formation
encounter.iron_broken_formation.objectiv: Reconnect the scattered army and complete the primary battle objective
encounter.iron_forward_outpost.name: Forward Outpost
encounter.iron_forward_outpost.objective: Activate the outpost and hold it for the announced number of actions
encounter.iron_champions_net.name: Champion's Net
encounter.iron_champions_net.objective: Break the elite coordination pattern and finish without losing the king
encounter.iron_escort_through_check.name: Escort through Check
encounter.iron_escort_through_check.obje: Guide Tomas Gatekeeper to the exit while legally answering every check
boss.iron_regent.name: The Iron Regent
boss.iron_regent.objective.furnace_seals: Break three visible seals while preserving a legal king position
boss.iron_regent.objective.collapsing_fo: Checkmate the Iron Regent before the announced cells close
